scheme_name: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - General Term Loan (GTL)
other_conditions: Applicants must be Safai Karamcharis (including wastepickers), identified manual scavengers, or their dependents
Registered co‑operative societies of the target group are eligible
Legally constituted associations or firms promoted by the target group are eligible
Applicants may need to produce a certificate from a local Revenue Officer, Municipal Officer, Cantonment Executive Officer, Railway Officer, or a Gazetted‑rank Head of a Government Department
Mukhia/Sarpanch/President or equivalent authority can issue an Occupation Certificate for Safai Karamcharis/dependents
If the applicant is identified as a manual scavenger in the survey, no certificate is required once their name appears in the final list prepared by the State/UT
benefits_summary: Term loan up to 90 % of project cost (maximum Rs 15 lakh) at 6 % interest, repayable over up to 10 years after a short implementation and moratorium period.
documents_required: Certificate from Head of Government Department (Gazetted rank)
Certificate of inclusion in the final list of Manual Scavengers prepared by State/UT
